keyword: concrete pump 60 which model to order

title.en: Searching “60”: Four Xingtai Pages Use That Number
title.zh: 搜索“60”：邢台有四张页用到这个数字

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60, Electric Low Pressure 60, Diesel 60 and LZ-60 as separate orders. Outputs are 40, 35, 35 and 50 m³/h.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60、电动低压60、柴油60和 LZ-60 分成不同订单。输送量是 40、35、35 和 50 m³/h。

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not collapse the number 60 into one pump. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and hopper 0.7 m³. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 75 kW, the label Electric 75-60, 35 m³/h and hopper 0.5 m³. Diesel 60 prints 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h and the string HBT60-13.132. LZ-60 prints the same string with 145 kW, 50 m³/h and 5500 kg. Order by path.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把数字 60 并成一台泵。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。电动低压60印 75 kW、标注 Electric 75-60、35 m³/h、料斗 0.5 m³。柴油60印 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h 和字符串 HBT60-13.132。LZ-60 印同一字符串，但是 145 kW、50 m³/h、5500 kg。按路径下单。

body.en: Diesel 60 and LZ-60 both print HBT60-13.132. Diesel 60 then prints 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 350 m, 3500 kg and no aggregate cell. LZ-60 prints 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m, height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 5500 kg.
body.zh: 柴油60和 LZ-60 都印 HBT60-13.132。柴油60随后印 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m、3500 kg，并且没有骨料格。LZ-60 印 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、5500 kg。

body.en: Electric 60 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. Electric Low Pressure 60 prints 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. The low-pressure page is not a lighter copy of the same outline.

If you are comparing, list the paths and the condition (grid kilowatts or diesel). Ask Hebei Pinjin Machinery to price the chosen URL via [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Do not ask for a blended “60 m³/h” machine. None of these four pages prints 60 m³/h.
body.zh: 如果还在比较，列出路径和条件（电网千瓦或柴油）。请河北品锦机械通过 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 对选定的地址报价。不要要一台混合出来的“60 m³/h”机器。这四页都没有印 60 m³/h。

answer.en: A label printed on the Electric Low Pressure 60 page beside 75 kW.
answer.zh: 印在电动低压60页上、靠着 75 kW 的一个标注。

answer.en: The page states that aggregate size is not printed. Leave it blank and send your measured stone.
answer.zh: 该页写明未印骨料粒径。保持空白，并发送你量到的石子。
